migration.IR-01Equivalence: Old: filter every body of the owner prefix by admissionOrdinal < boundary ordinal, then cold selectValidatedRuntimeEventPrefix. New: the existing cut owner. On a located (owned) prefix it uses rowById(eventId), selection.cut(ordinal-1) and selectLocatedSubset, keeping the owned source and scope. On a validated prefix it uses an id-index lookup, a binary search and constructImmutablePrefix with the receipt source. In every case the boundary event comes from the same prefix: the bridge events are selected over the same basis-authenticated prefix, and the projection results are iterated from runtimeEventBodiesAtPrefix(prefix) or read by id at the same prefix. Every prefix the callers hold is unscoped (authenticated owned assembly prefix, scope all). So values, order, extent, profile and digest are equal, and the boundary is excluded (focused case historicalCut). Exceptions in all three callers are still caught to null, and the source, causation, currentness and physical checks after each cut are unchanged.
migration.IR-02Equivalence: Each retired adapter was {...owned, events: runtimeEventBodiesAtPrefix(owned.prefix).materialize(), prefix: selectValidatedRuntimeEventPrefix(events)}, with a null guard for a runtime_validation_event_prefix. None of the seven callers reads owner.events. Their owner.prefix readers (projectRunEnvironmentRoleEvidenceAtPrefix, indexedRuntimeEvents, semanticJobRootAtPrefix and the other instruction-assembly prefix readers) accept RuntimeEventPrefix. The other owner facts are the same objects. The guard is unreachable: authenticateOwnedNativeInstructionAssemblyBasis takes its prefix from projectOwnedPrefixArtifactTruth, which is always an owned prefix. The focused case semanticAdapter shows equal facts and refusal.
